Simulated baseline data of a two-arm trial

Source: R/data.R
baseline_data.Rd

Simulated baseline characteristics of 271 participants in a two-arm randomised trial in tetanus ("Intrathecal treatment" vs "Sham procedure"), used in the examples, tests and vignette. The data are entirely simulated (see `data-raw/simulate_data.R` in the source package); they do not describe real people. The same data are in `inst/extdata/baseline_data.csv`.

Usage

baseline_data

Format

A data frame with 271 rows and 61 columns:

usubjid

participant ID, `"SIM-001"` to `"SIM-271"`

age

age in years (integer)

sex

`"F"` or `"M"`

bmi

body mass index (kg/m^2)

source

source of admission, coded 1 or 2

tetanus

tetanus diagnosis, always `"Y"`

icudays

days in the intensive care unit (a few missing)

outcome

outcome, coded 2, 3 or 4

hypertension, myocardialinfart, angina, perivascular, chronicpul, connectivetissue, mildliver, hemiplegia, diawithchronic, severeliver, aids, cardiacfailureiii, cerebrovascular, severeresp, pepticulcer, diabetes, severekidney, malignancy, tumour, dementia, renalfailure, electivesurgery, emergencysurgery

comorbidities, `"Y"` or `"N"` (a few missing)

timetoadm

days from onset to admission

incubationperiod, incuperiodonset

incubation period and period of onset (often missing)

wound

`"Deep"` or `"Superficial/other"`

diffbreath

difficulty breathing, `"Y"` or `"N"`

ablettscore

Ablett score, `"I"`, `"II"` or `"III"`

asa

ASA physical status, 1 to 3

maxtemp, resp, fio2, spo2, pao2, ph, plt, wbc, hct, maxhr, minhr, maxsbp, worstdbp, worstsbp, na, k, creat

vital signs and laboratory values (`pao2` and `ph` mostly missing)

vaso

vasopressors, `"Y"` or `"N"`

apacheii, sofa, tss

APACHE II, SOFA and tetanus severity scores

Arm

randomised arm, `"Intrathecal treatment"` or `"Sham procedure"`

pain_score

pain score, 1 to 5

Source

Simulated with `data-raw/simulate_data.R`.

See also

[ae_data], [sstable.baseline()]
